from pathlib import Path

p = Path("glm-worker/internal/autoresume/codex_wake_transaction.go")
text = p.read_text()
old = "func readWakeTOMLForThread(path, entryName, wakeThreadID string) (wakeAutomation, string) {"
new = "func readWakeTOMLForThread(path, entryName, wakeThreadID string) (AutomationTOML, string) {"
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("wake helper type replacement mismatch")
p.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
